description: Browse the fonds register of the National Archives of Georgia — roughly 14,650 fonds across 586 pages, 25 per page. Each row gives the holding regional archive, the archive name, the fond number, the fond name, the historical names the fond carried with their date ranges, and the inclusive dates of its administrative and personnel records. Browse only: the register has no query API.

page.description: Page number, 1-586. 25 fonds per page. Defaults to 1.

name: archives_fonds_browse
